judgments.reason: The quoted short stature is stated literally and supports the Albright hereditary osteodystrophy phenotype associated with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A.
The quoted severe hypocalcemia occurs literally and supports PTH resistance, a core biochemical feature of pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A.
The quoted elevated PTH occurs literally and, together with hypocalcemia, supports PTH resistance consistent with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A.
